title: Lithonia Middle school
subtitle: Washington, D.C. April 16-19, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Lithonia Middle School. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Travel to Washington, D.C. & National 9/11 Pentagon Memorial

  • Travel to Washington, D.C.!
  • Dinner Allocation
  • Visit the National 9/11 Pentagon Memorial
  • Hotel Accommodations with overnight security (three nights)

Day 2: Arlington National Cemetery & National Museum of African American History and Culture 

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the US Marine Corps War Memorial: Iwo Jima
  • Tour Director Led Walking Tour of Arlington National Cemetery
  • Visit the People’s House
  • Photo Opp at The White House
  • Lunch
  • Visit the National Museum of African American History and Culture 
  • Visit the National Museum of American History
  • Dinner Allocation
  • Visit the Lincoln Memorial, Vietnam, and Korean War Memorials, World War II Memorial, and Washington Monument
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations

Day 3: Library of Congress & United States Capitol Building Tour

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the Supreme Court Building Exhibit 
  • Visit the Library of Congress
  • Lunch 
  • Public Guided Tour of the United States Capitol Building 
  • Group Exploration of the Smithsonian Museums
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations 

Day 4: Smithsonian National Zoological Park & Departure for Home

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the Smithsonian National Zoological Park
  • Depart for Home
introHeading: Lithonia Middle School, get ready for an unforgettable Washington, D.C. adventure in 2027! 🏛️
introText: This Washington, D.C. journey blends monuments, museums, and moments of reflection into an unforgettable student experience! Travelers will pay tribute at the Pentagon Memorial and the Marine Corps War Memorial, walk the solemn grounds of Arlington National Cemetery, and snap a photo outside the White House. They'll dive into powerful exhibits at the National Museum of African American History and Culture and the National Museum of American History, then stand before the Lincoln, Vietnam, Korean War, and World War II Memorials along with the Washington Monument. The trip also includes stops at the Supreme Court, the Library of Congress, the U.S. Capitol, the Smithsonian museums, and the National Zoo — a well-rounded blend of history, culture, and discovery your students will carry with them long after the trip ends!
